company.name: Helonic
company.shortDescription: Helonic provides an AI platform that analyzes construction drawings to detect coordination conflicts, code issues, and design errors in PDFs
company.description: Helonic develops an AI platform for construction drawing analysis that focuses on preconstruction and document review workflows. The software analyzes 2D PDF plans across architectural, structural, MEP and other disciplines to detect coordination conflicts, code compliance issues, missing information and dimensional discrepancies. It highlights issues with page locations, severity and recommended next steps so project teams can review and act. Helonic also generates draft RFIs tied to specific drawings and integrates with tools such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam and email to fit existing project management workflows. Contractors, engineers, architects and subcontractors use the platform to streamline plan review, drawing control and coordination before work begins on site. The product is designed to reduce manual markup effort and surface drawing issues earlier in the project lifecycle.
